title: A Bowl for the Immune Team
text: Carrot, access granted! Today, steamed eggs to help nourish my immune team!
speaker: Chef Immune

title: Just Three Ingredients
text: Two eggs, fifty grams of carrot, and one hundred milliliters of water. Just a little salt if you like.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01  Finely Grate the Carrot
text: Finely grate the carrot. Small pieces cook tenderly inside the eggs!
speaker: Chef Immune

title: 02  Beat, Mix, and Pour
text: Beat the eggs, mix in water and carrot, and pour into a heatproof bowl.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03  Steam over Medium-Low Heat
text: Into the steaming pot, then cover! Cook over medium-low heat for about twelve minutes.
speaker: Chef Immune

title: Cook the Center All the Way Through
text: No runny egg in the center! Soft steamed eggs, dotted with carrot, are ready!
speaker: Chef Immune

title: Why Immune Chose Carrot
text: Your body can turn the beta-carotene in carrots into vitamin A. Vitamin A is needed for your immune system to work normally.
speaker: Narrator

title: Get Nutrients from Varied Foods
text: Eating more doesn't make you invincible! Get the nutrients you need from a variety of foods.
speaker: Narrator

title: Taste Inspection Is My Job!
text: I'll handle the taste inspection. Hmm, I think this needs another inspection. One more bite!
speaker: Chef Immune

title: Screenshot Your Next Side!
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Immune
